title: Pure SaaS Design Styles Catalog
description: Curated catalog of UI/UX design archetypes, product taxonomies, and stack guidance adapted from ui-ux-pro-max-skill (MIT License, Copyright (c) 2024 Next Level Builder).

styles.name: Minimalism & Swiss Style

typography.tracking: tight on headings (-0.02em to -0.03em), normal on body

styles.anti_slop_notes: Avoid decorative gradient meshes, glowing text, and unnecessary drop shadows. Let typography and layout structure the hierarchy.

styles.name: Technical Terminal & Infrastructure

typography.tracking: tighter on headings (-0.025em), monospaced on numbers and code

styles.anti_slop_notes: Hero must demonstrate real code, endpoint execution, or terminal output. Never use fake vanity metrics or generic gradients.

styles.name: Data-Dense Operations Console
styles.anti_slop_notes: Use tabular numbers for all financial and metric data. Avoid oversized cards; use compact tables with sticky headers.

styles.name: Editorial Literary & Publishing

typography.tracking: normal to loose on body, optical serif weights

styles.anti_slop_notes: Banish cards from reading surfaces. Use typographic hierarchy, hairline dividers, and margin notes.

styles.name: Creative Studio & Media Sequencing
styles.anti_slop_notes: Media preview canvas must dominate the viewport. Interface controls remain neutral studio grey so they do not distort color perception.

styles.name: Modern Enterprise Workflow SaaS
styles.anti_slop_notes: Support full keyboard shortcuts (Cmd+K). Avoid floating pill navigation bars and repetitive 3-column feature cards.

styles.name: Bento Box Grid & Visual Showcase
styles.anti_slop_notes: Every bento tile must have unique aspect ratios and content types (code demo, interactive preview, stat graphic). Never build identical 3-column boxes.

styles.name: Clean Consumer & E-Commerce
styles.anti_slop_notes: CTAs must have unambiguous contrast. Do not hide product imagery behind colored gradient overlays.

styles.name: High-Contrast FinTech & Capital Markets
styles.anti_slop_notes: Use unambiguous status colors (green = positive return, red = negative return). Always align tabular numbers right.

styles.name: Healthcare & Clinical Trust
styles.anti_slop_notes: Accessibility is mandatory (WCAG AAA contrast on critical text). Avoid anxiety-inducing flashing animations or micro-copy.

styles.name: Spatial & Tactile Glass
styles.anti_slop_notes: Glass must function as a translucent depth separator with backdrop-filter, not a gratuitous decorative blob. Never sacrifice WCAG contrast.

styles.name: Neo-Brutalist & High-Energy
styles.anti_slop_notes: Use hard, un-blurred offset box shadows (4px 4px 0px #000). Avoid soft gradients or rounded squircle pills.

saas_general.name: SaaS (General B2B / Cloud)
saas_general.landing_pattern: Hero + Live Interactive Preview + Proof + Pricing
saas_general.color_focus: Trust neutral canvas (#ffffff) with high-contrast accent
saas_general.key_considerations: Clarity of value proposition, instantaneous demo, zero fluff.

micro_saas.name: Micro SaaS & Indie Products
micro_saas.color_focus: Punchy primary accent + clean negative space
micro_saas.key_considerations: Fast page weight, immediate video/interactive preview.

developer_tools.name: Developer Tools & Infrastructure
developer_tools.dashboard_style: High-density log viewer and metrics console
developer_tools.color_focus: Dark mode canvas (#0c0d0e) with terminal highlight accent
developer_tools.key_considerations: Real code snippets, copyable curl commands, keyboard shortcuts.

ecommerce.name: E-Commerce & Retail
ecommerce.landing_pattern: Editorial product showcase with direct add-to-cart
ecommerce.color_focus: Neutral canvas letting product photography lead
ecommerce.key_considerations: Fast image loading, large touch targets, frictionless checkout.

fintech.name: FinTech, Banking & Capital Markets
fintech.dashboard_style: Tabular real-time positions and PnL monitor
fintech.color_focus: Dark navy or pure white with strict green/red return indicators
fintech.key_considerations: Tabular numbers mandatory, explicit fee transparency, high security feel.

analytics_bi.name: Analytics, BI & Observability
analytics_bi.dashboard_style: Modular KPI grid with drill-down tables
analytics_bi.color_focus: Neutral slate canvas with categorical chart colors
analytics_bi.key_considerations: Zero fake data visualization; compact padding; sticky headers.

healthcare.name: Healthcare, Clinic & Medical
healthcare.dashboard_style: High-clarity patient timeline and vitals record
healthcare.color_focus: Calm emerald/blue with WCAG AAA contrast
healthcare.key_considerations: Screen reader support, zero cognitive overload, accessible error messaging.

portfolio_creative.name: Creative Agency & Portfolio
portfolio_creative.landing_pattern: Project case study narrative with full-bleed media
portfolio_creative.dashboard_style: Asset timeline and client deliverables manager
portfolio_creative.color_focus: Deep studio grey or crisp archival paper
portfolio_creative.key_considerations: Typographic distinctiveness, fluid transitions, no cookie-cutter cards.

productivity.name: Productivity & Collaboration
productivity.landing_pattern: Interactive board demo with instant action
productivity.color_focus: Subtle border hierarchy with intentional action blue
productivity.key_considerations: Complete keyboard navigation (Cmd+K, j/k cursor), optimistic updates.

mobile_app.name: Native Mobile & Multi-Platform Application
mobile_app.landing_pattern: App store preview with dynamic device mockups
mobile_app.dashboard_style: Bottom tab bar + sheet modal navigation
mobile_app.color_focus: Platform dynamic system colors adapting to light and dark mode
mobile_app.key_considerations: Minimum 44pt touch targets, safe area insets, swipe gestures.

react_nextjs.name: React / Next.js (App Router)
patterns: Use CSS Modules or Tailwind CSS with semantic token CSS variables (--color-bg-surface, etc.)
Extract interactive logic to Client Components ('use client'), keep layouts and server data fetching in Server Components
Implement accessible Radix UI or React Aria primitives for dialogs, dropdowns, and comboboxes
Support keyboard focus management and autofocus on modal open

tailwind.name: Tailwind CSS (v3 / v4)
patterns: Map all utility classes to semantic CSS variables in tailwind.config: bg-surface, text-primary, text-secondary, border-subtle
Reject arbitrary bracket dimensions (e.g. p-[17px]) in favor of standard 4px/8px spacing scale
Never use unmapped raw palette classes (e.g. bg-blue-500) directly in UI components
Use focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-accent instead of bare outline-none

vue_nuxt.name: Vue 3 / Nuxt
patterns: Use Composition API with <script setup>
Leverage Headless UI or Radix Vue for accessible keyboard interactions
Bind semantic CSS custom properties in scoped <style> blocks

svelte_kit.name: Svelte 5 / SvelteKit
patterns: Use Svelte 5 Runes ($state, $derived, $effect) for reactive state
Use Bits UI or Melt UI for headless accessible components
Encapsulate styles with scoped CSS and semantic custom properties

vanilla_web.name: Modern HTML5 & CSS
patterns: Define all tokens as CSS custom properties under :root and [data-theme='dark']
Use native <dialog> element with showModal() for accessible modal behavior
Use CSS Container Queries (@container) and clamp() for fluid typography

react_native.name: React Native & Expo
patterns: Use useColorScheme() for dynamic dark/light appearance adaptation
Enforce minimum 44x44pt hitSlop or size on all Pressable components
Wrap views with SafeAreaView and handle KeyboardAvoidingView

swiftui.name: SwiftUI (Apple Platforms)
patterns: Use Color(uiColor: .systemBackground) and semantic system styles
Adopt Dynamic Type via .font(.body), .font(.title3)
Adopt SF Symbols with .symbolRenderingMode(.hierarchical)
